model_annotation: The data in the bar and pillar chart shows per capita GDP by region in North America and Europe in 2021 and 2022, respectively. The regions shown are Germany and Switzerland, and the data is presented in thousands of 2017 U.S. dollars. The lowest GDP per capita is in Switzerland at 49.5 thousand dollars in 2021, and the highest GDP per capita is in Switzerland at 52.4 thousand dollars in 2022. The absolute GDP in Germany is 6.2 trillion dollars in 2021, and the absolute GDP in Switzerland is 644.2 billion dollars in 2021.
